objectClass.notes: The reference is a compression machine. The screw must visibly connect crossbeam to pressure plate and the basket must remain hollow/slatted.

reasoning: The splayed frame, screw, round basket, side ratchet and front bucket create multiple overlapping action systems.
Twenty-two basket staves, multiple hoops, visible thread, apple cargo and fasteners require explicit repetition systems.
Juice flow, wet wood and fruit must read separately from dry structural oak and iron.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Complex depth is required by the load path, circular stave basket, threaded mechanism, crank and visible liquid path.

unknownsToResolveBeforeImplementation: Internal crushed fruit is inferred as a compact pulp mass with partial apples.
The juice stream is a controlled transparent mesh rather than fluid simulation.

details.description: Four thick oak posts lean inward from independent limestone feet.
Four irregular limestone blocks isolate the oak from ground moisture and carry moss.
An oversized crossbeam spans the frame with two projected iron straps and rivets.
Four lower diagonal braces and side rails prevent rack deformation.
A carved wooden core carries a continuous nine-turn projected thread beneath an octagonal nut.
A long iron turning bar ends in two wood grips with ferrules.
Eight oak segments and two iron hoops form a layered circular pressure plate.
Twenty-two tapered vertical staves form a truly slatted round basket.
Three black iron hoops and distributed rivets clamp the basket staves.
Dark crushed pulp and partial russet apples remain visible beneath the plate.
A circular collection tray terminates in a carved front spout with a wet groove.
Amber cider drips into a separate fourteen-stave iron-hooped bucket.
A toothed side ratchet, pawl, crank arm and wood grip form a complete control system.
A slatted side crate carries fifteen varied russet apples with several loose fruit nearby.
A tied rope coil and folded cider-stained cloth occupy the opposite ground corner.

anatomy.note: Object domain; character anatomy is not applicable.

definitionOfDone: The frame visibly carries screw load into a slatted basket and tray; crank, fruit and juice output remain readable in main and side review.

qualityCriteria: Splayed posts, braces, crossbeam and stone feet form a credible compression frame.
Threaded screw, turning bar and segmented plate connect without gaps.
Slatted basket, tray, spout, stream and bucket remain distinct.
Dry/wet oak, iron, fruit, cider, stone, rope and cloth respond independently.

antiShallowSpecRules: No barrel with a screw floating above it may pass.
The basket may not be a solid cylinder.
The juice path must terminate in a separate catch bucket.
